description:
1. Read rx_chain_requirements.csv: identify n77/n78 band (3.3-4.2GHz), SP4T switch requirement with IL≤0.5dB, cascade NF budget of 3.5dB, and 3.5GHz filter need.
2. Select MXD8641 (SP4T, IL<0.5dB) as antenna switch - the only SP4T model in SKILL.md meeting the IL requirement.
3. Select MXD1805 (3.3-4.2GHz, NF=1.2dB, Gain=15dB) as LNA - the only model covering the full n77 band.
4. Select MXF2201 (BAW, 3.5GHz, 5G n78, IL=1.5dB) as filter - the correct BAW (not SAW) filter for this frequency.
5. Apply Friis cascade formula: F_total = F_switch + (F_filter-1)/G_switch + (F_lna-1)/(G_switch*G_filter) using IL-as-NF for passive components. With switch NF=0.5dB/G=-0.5dB, filter NF=1.5dB/G=-1.5dB, LNA NF=1.2dB/G=15dB → NF_total ≈ 3.20dB.
6. Mark passes_requirement=true since 3.20dB < 3.5dB budget.
7. Parse test log symptoms and map to SKILL.md FAQ Q2 (LNA NF超标) troubleshooting checklist: input matching issue (not at optimal noise match point), supply voltage droop (2.85V vs 3.0V → check ripple), insufficient ground vias (3 vias noted), and long input trace (18mm). Also note the output return loss failure (-8.1dB vs -10dB target) from SKILL.md section 2.2 design requirements.
8. Output all findings in feasibility_report.json.
